title: [CRY-25] RFC section citations are wrong
description: Review finding CRY-25: RFC section citations are wrong (lens CRY). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:55, spec/02-identity.md:225, spec/12-security.md:93. Fix: Checked against rfc9420.txt headings. §10 is Key Packages and has only §10.1, so §10.3 does not exist. §11 is Group Creation and has only §11.1-§11.3, so §11.5 does not exist. Exporters is §8.5 (rfc9420.txt:3210). The DS and AS roles are defined in RFC 9750. Cite RFC 9420 §8.5 and RFC 9750. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Only RFC 9420 §10.1 cited (spec/05-messaging.md l57, l120); exporter cited as RFC 9420 §8.5 (l273); DS/AS roles cite RFC 9750 (l72); no §10.3/§11.5 citations remain
